name.ja: ピカちんキット０５ ゼロゼロマーカー

description.ja: • テレビ番組「ポチっと発明 ピカちんキット」に登場するゼロゼロマーカーが商品化！
description.en: • The zero-zero marker that appears on the TV program "Pochitto Invention Pikachin Kit" has been commercialized!

description.ja: • 仲間同士で秘密のメッセージのやり取りができちゃう発明品！
description.en: • An invention that allows friends to exchange secret messages!

description.ja: • 他の人に見られたくない大切な言葉も白昼堂々書きまくれる！
description.en: • You can write important words in broad daylight that you don't want others to see!

description.ja: • ピカちん大百科に綴じられるピカちんシートも付いてくるぞ！
description.en: • It also comes with a Pikachin sheet that can be bound into the Pikachin Encyclopedia!
